_doc: Weapon and damage effects (I87), read by game/scripts/world/effects_view.gd. A weapon's look is families[f] overlaid by weapons[special_fx] and then components[component id]. 'original' blocks come from tools/art/weapon_fx_original.py (the Shared Source bolt FITs and Effects.csv) and are the baseline the look was tuned from; the code never reads them. Sizes in metres, times in seconds, colours #rrggbb. Impacts and explosions are lists of particle elements (emitter: flash|spark|fire|smoke|dust|debris|splash) plus an optional light and ring.

emitters._doc: The shared particle pools. life is the pool's longest particle life (each particle carries its own); shader add = glowing, mix = lit smoke, debris = lit chunks. size is a particle's diameter, grow adds multiples of it over the life.

forms._why: fallback special_fx when a shot names no component

deaths._doc: Sequences: [t, impact, offset_up_fraction]. size scales every element (1 = a 10 m mech). column: lingering smoke (s, puffs/s at the start, puff size); burn: flames at the base (s). Columns drift with 'wind' (m/s, x and z).

damage._doc: Damaged units: smoke from the damage fraction 'smoke_from' up, rate rising to 'smoke_rate' puffs/s; at 'critical' and above, sparks and flames too. A destroyed location also smokes.
